styles.colorLogic: Палитра выбирается из: Е1 — warm cream #F5F0E8 background with black text — classic always-works combination | Е2 — dark charcoal #1C1C1C background with cream or white text — proven in testing | Е3 — sage green #E8EDE6 background with forest green #2D4A2D text — natural calm | Е4 — dusty rose #F2E0DC background with deep espresso #2C1A1A text — feminine warm | Е5 — warm terracotta #E8D5C4 background with deep brown text — autumn cozy | Е6 — cool linen #EAE8E4 background with slate gray #4A4A4A text — Scandinavian minimal | Е7 — bold accent color (cobalt blue or coral or mustard yellow) with white or black text — maximalist energy | Е8 — soft pastel mix: baby pink, lavender, mint together — Gen Z aesthetic | Е9 — monochrome: single color family in multiple tones only — sophisticated restraint | Е10 — full dark mode #0A0A0A background with bright accent color text — night energy | Е11 — faded retro tones: muted ochre, mustard, dusty blue — vintage 70s magazine | Е12 — no separate background — text placed directly on the photograph. Атмосфера и свет съёмки: Ж1 — golden hour warm sunset light, outdoor urban or nature setting, long soft shadows | Ж2 — clean professional studio, white or neutral background, controlled even lighting | Ж3 — overcast day soft diffused light, candid photojournalistic street style | Ж4 — warm ambient cafe or interior light, cozy indoor lifestyle setting | Ж5 — soft morning window light, at-home setting, relaxed lazy morning feel | Ж6 — analog film look: slight overexposure, grain, faded shadows, film aesthetic | Ж7 — moody dim indoor or night location, single point light source, dark atmosphere | Ж8 — bright midday summer sunlight, hard shadows, very high contrast, summer energy | Ж9 — natural outdoor setting: forest, field, or park with soft diffused green light | Ж10 — airy minimalist white or very light background, studio-adjacent but not clinical.
styles.decorative: Декор-элементы: Г1 — vertical column of 3-4 small icon circles with bold label text beside each — list-style decoration | Г2 — small decorative stickers scattered on the pin: star, heart, sparkle shapes | Г3 — colorful washi tape strips on photo corners, scrapbook aesthetic | Г4 — torn paper edge effect between sections instead of a clean straight line | Г5 — hand-drawn arrow graphics pointing to key elements | Г6 — small counter label in corner: 1 of [COUNT] — implies more content inside | Г7 — small NEW or TRENDING stamp badge near the headline | Г8 — one keyword in the headline underlined with a colored wavy or straight line | Г9 — thin decorative border frame around the entire pin, can be double-line | Г10 — geometric shapes (circles, triangles, rectangles) as background decoration or accents | Г11 — halftone dot pattern on background or one section — retro pop art effect | Г12 — subtle 35mm film grain overlay on the entire pin — analog vintage character | Г13 — colored rectangular highlight block directly behind a text line, like a marker | Г14 — no decorative accents — clean photo and text only, pure editorial. CTA-элементы: Д1 — pill-shaped rounded button graphic with CTA text inside reading exactly: [CTA_PHRASE] | Д2 — torn paper strip with washi tape accent, typewriter font text reading exactly: [CTA_PHRASE] | Д3 — rectangular stamped badge with rough ink edges, CTA text inside reading exactly: [CTA_PHRASE] | Д4 — arrow-shaped tag pointing right with text reading exactly: [CTA_PHRASE] | Д5 — intrigue text hook without button, text reads exactly: [CTA_PHRASE] | Д6 — simple underlined text link style with text reading exactly: [CTA_PHRASE] — minimal editorial CTA | Д7 — frosted glass semi-transparent card with title, short checklist, and a button inside with text: [CTA_PHRASE] | Д8 — solid dark color strip at bottom of pin with white text and a small button, text reads: [CTA_PHRASE] — editorial bottom bar | Д9 — large teaser text as CTA reading exactly: [CTA_PHRASE] — the phrase itself is the CTA | Д10 — no CTA element — organic lifestyle pin without promotional feel. Фразы CTA берутся из пула: See all ideas → | Get the full list → | Save for later → | Tap for more → | Discover more → | Explore ideas → | Full guide inside → | Swipe for more → | Read the guide → | Steal the look → | Try these ideas → | Get inspired → | See more looks → | Full breakdown → | Bookmark this → | Peek inside → | Full list on blog → | Shop the look → | Click for details → | More on the blog →. Отображение года: В1 — the exact digits [YEAR] as a giant semi-transparent decorative background element, like a watermark | В2 — the exact digits [YEAR] inside a circle sticker graphic with colored fill, like a label sticker | В3 — year in a thin full-width horizontal banner strip: text TREND [YEAR] | В4 — the exact digits [YEAR] in small italic font below the main headline, subtle and unobtrusive | В5 — the exact digits [YEAR] as a tiny corner label, like a date stamp on a photograph | В6 — the exact digits [YEAR] in a contrasting accent color within the headline text | В7 — the exact digits [YEAR] in a sharp-cornered rectangular tag badge, like a price tag or label | В9 — no year shown — pin feels evergreen and timeless.
styles.avoid: PHOTO QUALITY (always required): Canon EOS R5, photojournalistic realism, NO CGI, NO 3D render, NO plastic skin, NO distorted faces, NO AI artifacts. Число идей не должно повторяться дважды на пине. Год на пине только точный целевой год, никаких выдуманных 2024 или 2025. Только один CTA на пин. Заголовок только горизонтальный, без вертикального или повёрнутого текста.

styles.promptTemplate:
=== SPLIT PINS ===
USER INSTRUCTIONS:
=== PIN TYPE: SPLIT — HORIZONTAL SLICES (OUTFITS) ===
LAYOUT: Frame divided into horizontal slices with thin text bands.
SLICE 1 (top, 27% height): Ultra-realistic DSLR fashion photo of woman in [OUTFIT 1 — e.g. linen co-ord set].
POSE: mid-stride toward camera. Location: city street golden hour.
Canon EOS R5 50mm. Photojournalistic. NO CGI. NO 3D. Full width.
TEXT BAND 1 (8% height): Solid color strip.
LEFT: bold '[TOPIC_COUNT] [TOPIC_KEYWORD]' condensed.
RIGHT: '[YEAR]' accent italic.
SLICE 2 (middle, 25% height): Ultra-realistic DSLR of DIFFERENT woman in [OUTFIT 2 — e.g. floral midi dress].
POSE: turning with hair movement, candid energy. Location: cafe terrace. Full width.
Different color grade — cooler or warmer than Slice 1.
TEXT BAND 2 (8% height): Contrasting color.
Centered italic phrase — vary: 'outfits that do the talking' / 'dress like you mean it' / 'effortless every time'.
SLICE 3 (22% height): Ultra-realistic DSLR of THIRD different woman in [OUTFIT 3 — e.g. oversized blazer].
POSE: sitting on steps relaxed, confident look. Location: rooftop or park. Full width.
BOTTOM STRIP (10% height): Bold accent color.
Pill button 'See all [TOPIC_COUNT] outfits →' centered white text.
If [SITE_NAME]: tiny tracking caps.
CRITICAL: 3 completely different women, 3 different outfits, 3 different locations and light moods.
=== END SPLIT OUTFITS ===
- type: "split"
- photoCount: 3
Topic headline text on the pin, language {language}: {count} {topic} {year}
Season context if used: {season}
VISUAL STYLE (apply all instructions exactly):
- HEADLINE FONT STYLE: {g1}
- NUMBER DISPLAY: {g2}
- YEAR DISPLAY: {g3}
- DECORATIVE ACCENTS: {g4}
- CTA ELEMENT: {g5}
- COLOR PALETTE: {g6}
- SHOOTING ATMOSPHERE: {g7}
- YEAR OVERRIDE: the year to display MUST be exactly "{year}", never infer or invent another year. If no year is selected: do NOT show any year, year badge, date label, or 20xx text anywhere on this pin.
- NUMBER OVERRIDE: the count "{count}" appears exclusively inside the NUMBER DISPLAY element — never twice on the pin. If the NUMBER DISPLAY element is active, the headline MUST NOT contain the digits "{count}".
- CTA OVERRIDE: use ONLY the CTA element above. Only one CTA allowed on the entire pin. The CTA MUST NOT contain the count number.
PHOTO QUALITY (always required): Canon EOS R5, photojournalistic realism, NO CGI, NO 3D render, NO plastic skin, NO distorted faces, NO AI artifacts.
Generate image with aspect ratio - {aspect}

styles.name: Кулинария — Тоби (Tobi)
styles.concept: Формат «Тоби» для темы «Кулинария». Одно фото-герой, крупный заголовок поверх или рядом.
styles.layout:
=== PIN TYPE: TOBI — SINGLE FOOD PHOTO + TEXT (COOKING) ===
SUBJECT: Ultra-realistic food photography of [DISH — vary each pin: the finished dish / a key ingredient closeup / a serving moment / a styled plate].
SHOOTING STYLE — vary each pin: overhead flat lay / classic 45° angle / dark moody / bright airy white / rustic wooden surface / extreme macro texture closeup.
CAMERA: Canon EOS R5 or Sony A7R, 50mm or 85mm or 100mm macro, natural or controlled studio light.
Food must look genuinely appetizing: glistening, textured, real. NO CGI. NO fake food. NO 3D render.
TEXT LAYOUT — vary each pin:
Option A: Text block TOP — headline above photo on separate solid color strip.
Option B: Text block BOTTOM — headline below photo on separate solid color strip.
Option C: Text overlay on photo — headline overlaid directly on photo (only if photo has dark area).
Option D: Text TOP and BOTTOM — small headline top, subtext or CTA bottom.
HEADLINE: [TOPIC_KEYWORD] in ALL CAPS, always readable, never vertical.
Do NOT place text over the main food subject — text goes in clear areas.
PHOTO QUALITY: professional food photography, ultra-realistic, NO CGI, NO 3D.
=== END TOBI COOKING ===

Text position varies: full-width strip across middle / top strip / bottom strip.
Text background: solid color or semi-transparent overlay for readability.
SHOOTING STYLE per photo: vary — overhead / 45° angle / closeup / styled plate.
PHOTO QUALITY: professional food photography, ultra-realistic, NO CGI, NO 3D.
=== END COLLAGE COOKING ===

styles.name: Кулинария — Типо (Tipo)
styles.concept: Формат «Типо» для темы «Кулинария». Типографический пин: текст доминирует над фото.
styles.layout:
=== PIN TYPE: TIPO — FOOD PHOTO + TEXT PANEL (COOKING) ===
LAYOUT: Vertical split. Photo panel [alternate left/right] occupies 60% of frame width. Text panel occupies 40%. Hard clean straight vertical edge. No blending.
PHOTO PANEL: Ultra-realistic food photo.
DISH — vary: hero dish beautifully plated / closeup of texture / overhead of finished meal.
SHOOTING STYLE — vary: overhead / 45° / macro / dark moody / bright airy.
Canon EOS R5, natural or studio light. NO CGI. NO 3D. NO text on photo.
TEXT PANEL: Solid color background — vary per pin:
Option A: warm cream #F5F0E8 with dark brown text.
Option B: dark charcoal #1C1C1C with cream text.
Option C: terracotta #D4856A with white text.
Option D: sage green #E8EDE6 with forest green text.
Option E: pure white with black text.
TEXT PANEL CONTENTS (top to bottom):
- Tiny label: vary — RECIPE / FOOD INSPO / COOKING
- Number [TOPIC_COUNT] large serif or bold sans — takes 25% of panel height
- Bold headline [TOPIC_KEYWORD] in 2-3 lines
- Hook element — vary: time / dietary badge / simple phrase
- Thin decorative rule
- CTA: pill button Get the recipe → or See all [TOPIC_COUNT] →
- If [SITE_NAME]: tiny tracking caps below button
NO text on photo side. Photo panel completely clean.

styles.concept: Формат «Аппетит» для темы «Кулинария». Макро-кадр еды, максимальный аппетитный эффект.
styles.layout:
=== PIN TYPE: APPETITE — ULTRA-APPETIZING MINIMAL FOOD PIN (COOKING) ===

PRIMARY GOAL: Make the viewer's mouth water instantly.
The food must look so genuinely delicious that someone would stop scrolling
and want to eat it immediately. This is the ONLY goal.

FOOD SUBJECT — vary each pin dramatically:
Rotate through different categories each time:
- Rich comfort food: bubbling cheese, golden crust, steaming pasta
- Fresh vibrant: colorful salads, bright fruits, vivid vegetables
- Indulgent desserts: glossy chocolate, dripping caramel, perfect frosting
- Protein hero: perfectly seared steak, golden chicken, fresh seafood
- Baked goods: golden bread crust, flaky pastry, soft cookies
- Soup and stew: rich broth, garnished bowl, steam rising
Make the specific dish relevant to [TOPIC_KEYWORD] but always at peak appetizing.

SHOOTING STYLE — vary each pin (pick one):
Style A: OVERHEAD MACRO — extreme close-up from directly above, filling entire frame, no background visible, pure texture.
Style B: 45-DEGREE HERO — classic food photography angle, dish centered, slight depth of field, beautiful background blur.
Style C: DARK MOODY — very dark background, single dramatic spotlight on food, restaurant fine-dining aesthetic, deep shadows.
Style D: DRIP AND POUR — action moment: sauce dripping, cheese pulling, honey pouring, glaze running — maximum temptation.
Style E: CROSS-SECTION — food cut in half revealing interior, perfect cross-section showing layers, fillings, textures.
Style F: STEAM AND HEAT — fresh from oven or stovetop, steam rising, condensation, heat visible, just-cooked moment.
Style G: RUSTIC SCENE — wooden surface, linen cloth, natural props, warm farmhouse lighting, cozy and inviting.

CAMERA: Canon EOS R5 or Sony A7R, 85mm or 100mm macro lens.
LIGHTING: varies by style — natural window light / single dramatic spotlight / soft diffused studio / warm golden side light.

APPETIZING REQUIREMENTS (all must be present):
- Food must look genuinely REAL and freshly prepared, never artificial
- Textures must be clearly visible: crispy, creamy, glossy, flaky, juicy
- Colors must be vivid and natural: golden browns, deep reds, fresh greens
- The single most tempting detail of the dish must be in perfect focus
- If liquid: it must look like it flows. If crispy: it must look like it crunches.
- NO CGI. NO 3D render. NO fake plastic food. NO stock photo generic look.
- NO busy backgrounds. Food must be clearly the hero.

TEXT — ABSOLUTE MINIMUM:
ONE text element only. Choose one option per pin (vary between pins):

Option A — BOTTOM CAPTION:
Very bottom of pin: thin solid strip (60px height) in one of these colors: black / deep charcoal / white / cream — whichever contrasts with the food.
Inside strip: [TOPIC_KEYWORD] in clean bold sans-serif, centered, white or dark text.
Nothing else. No buttons, no badges, no extra text.

Option B — FLOATING MINIMAL:
Small text directly on photo in a dark or light area (never over food center).
[TOPIC_KEYWORD] only. Clean thin tracking-caps font.
Position: bottom-left corner or top-left corner only.
Subtle drop shadow for readability. No background box.

HEADLINE IS MANDATORY. Always include [TOPIC_KEYWORD] as headline text on every pin. Never generate a pin without text.

NEVER add: CTA buttons, count numbers, year, decorative elements, badges, icons, borders, overlays, cards, or any other UI elements.
NEVER put text over the main food subject.
NEVER use vertical text.
If [SITE_NAME] is provided: add it as tiny 9px tracking caps in the very bottom right corner, very subtle, almost invisible. Only if Option A or B chosen.

PHOTO QUALITY: ultra-realistic professional food photography, shot to make the viewer feel they can almost taste the food through the screen.
=== END APPETITE COOKING ===

styles.promptTemplate:
=== APPETITE PINS ===
USER INSTRUCTIONS:
=== PIN TYPE: APPETITE — ULTRA-APPETIZING MINIMAL FOOD PIN (COOKING) ===

PRIMARY GOAL: Make the viewer's mouth water instantly.
The food must look so genuinely delicious that someone would stop scrolling
and want to eat it immediately. This is the ONLY goal.

FOOD SUBJECT — vary each pin dramatically:
Rotate through different categories each time:
- Rich comfort food: bubbling cheese, golden crust, steaming pasta
- Fresh vibrant: colorful salads, bright fruits, vivid vegetables
- Indulgent desserts: glossy chocolate, dripping caramel, perfect frosting
- Protein hero: perfectly seared steak, golden chicken, fresh seafood
- Baked goods: golden bread crust, flaky pastry, soft cookies
- Soup and stew: rich broth, garnished bowl, steam rising
Make the specific dish relevant to [TOPIC_KEYWORD] but always at peak appetizing.

SHOOTING STYLE — vary each pin (pick one):
Style A: OVERHEAD MACRO — extreme close-up from directly above, filling entire frame, no background visible, pure texture.
Style B: 45-DEGREE HERO — classic food photography angle, dish centered, slight depth of field, beautiful background blur.
Style C: DARK MOODY — very dark background, single dramatic spotlight on food, restaurant fine-dining aesthetic, deep shadows.
Style D: DRIP AND POUR — action moment: sauce dripping, cheese pulling, honey pouring, glaze running — maximum temptation.
Style E: CROSS-SECTION — food cut in half revealing interior, perfect cross-section showing layers, fillings, textures.
Style F: STEAM AND HEAT — fresh from oven or stovetop, steam rising, condensation, heat visible, just-cooked moment.
Style G: RUSTIC SCENE — wooden surface, linen cloth, natural props, warm farmhouse lighting, cozy and inviting.

CAMERA: Canon EOS R5 or Sony A7R, 85mm or 100mm macro lens.
LIGHTING: varies by style — natural window light / single dramatic spotlight / soft diffused studio / warm golden side light.

APPETIZING REQUIREMENTS (all must be present):
- Food must look genuinely REAL and freshly prepared, never artificial
- Textures must be clearly visible: crispy, creamy, glossy, flaky, juicy
- Colors must be vivid and natural: golden browns, deep reds, fresh greens
- The single most tempting detail of the dish must be in perfect focus
- If liquid: it must look like it flows. If crispy: it must look like it crunches.
- NO CGI. NO 3D render. NO fake plastic food. NO stock photo generic look.
- NO busy backgrounds. Food must be clearly the hero.

TEXT — ABSOLUTE MINIMUM:
ONE text element only. Choose one option per pin (vary between pins):

Option A — BOTTOM CAPTION:
Very bottom of pin: thin solid strip (60px height) in one of these colors: black / deep charcoal / white / cream — whichever contrasts with the food.
Inside strip: [TOPIC_KEYWORD] in clean bold sans-serif, centered, white or dark text.
Nothing else. No buttons, no badges, no extra text.

Option B — FLOATING MINIMAL:
Small text directly on photo in a dark or light area (never over food center).
[TOPIC_KEYWORD] only. Clean thin tracking-caps font.
Position: bottom-left corner or top-left corner only.
Subtle drop shadow for readability. No background box.

HEADLINE IS MANDATORY. Always include [TOPIC_KEYWORD] as headline text on every pin. Never generate a pin without text.

NEVER add: CTA buttons, count numbers, year, decorative elements, badges, icons, borders, overlays, cards, or any other UI elements.
NEVER put text over the main food subject.
NEVER use vertical text.
If [SITE_NAME] is provided: add it as tiny 9px tracking caps in the very bottom right corner, very subtle, almost invisible. Only if Option A or B chosen.

PHOTO QUALITY: ultra-realistic professional food photography, shot to make the viewer feel they can almost taste the food through the screen.
=== END APPETITE COOKING ===
- type: "appetite"
- photoCount: 1
Topic headline text on the pin, language {language}: {count} {topic} {year}
Season context if used: {season}
VISUAL STYLE (apply all instructions exactly):
- HEADLINE FONT STYLE: {g1}
- NUMBER DISPLAY: {g2}
- HOOK ELEMENT: {g3}
- DECORATIVE ACCENTS: {g4}
- CTA ELEMENT: {g5}
- COLOR PALETTE: {g6}
- SHOOTING STYLE: {g7}
- NUMBER OVERRIDE: the count "{count}" appears exclusively inside the NUMBER DISPLAY element — never twice on the pin. If the NUMBER DISPLAY element is active, the headline MUST NOT contain the digits "{count}".
- CTA OVERRIDE: use ONLY the CTA element above. Only one CTA allowed on the entire pin. The CTA MUST NOT contain the count number.
PHOTO QUALITY (always required): professional food photography, ultra-realistic, NO CGI, NO 3D render, NO fake-looking food, NO plastic-looking food.
Generate image with aspect ratio - {aspect}
